sections.heading: FEEDING
sections.subheading: I WILL RECEIVE IN RETURN OF MY BESTOWS.

body: Whether it's your birthday, wedding, graduation, Nika, or memorial, make your special day truly meaningful with Mary Joy Ethiopia. Instead of celebrating alone, share your joy with elders and children who need it most. Your celebration can bring warmth, love, and connection to those who rarely experience such moments of happiness.
USE THE FORM BELOW TO REGISTER

items.title: GRADUATION
items.text: Celebrate your achievement with Elders at Mary Joy Ethiopia – your success can feed a simle.

items.title: MEMORIAL
items.text: Honor your loved ones by feeding and comforting those in need.

items.title: BIRTHDAY
items.text: Celebrate your birthday with the children and elders at Mary Joy Ethiopia – where joy multipliles when shared.

items.title: WEDDING
items.text: Celebrate your wedding or Nika by sharing love with children and elders at Mary Joy Ethiopia.
